name: v0.2.1 – i18n translations & release branch fix
body:
## What's changed

### i18n translations

- **Hardcoded strings** are now translated: building tooltips, industry labels (e.g. surplus), and other UI text use `t()` with keys in `fr.json` / `en.json`.
- **Units** (MWh, m³, t, /day, /year) are translated via `units.*` keys and used in the production chain and surplus column.
- **Vehicle origins** and the **"present"** label are translated and shown in the app.

### Deploy / release branch

- Release branch is named from the version **without** the `v` prefix (e.g. `0.2.1`).
- Branch creation uses major.minor and skips if the branch already exists.

## Full changelog

- feat(i18n): translate units, vehicle origins and "present"
- feat(i18n): translate some hardcoded strings
- fix(deploy): use major.minor for release branch and skip if exists
- ci(deploy): name release branch after version without prefix

name: v0.2.0 – Co-products & surplus column
body:
## What's changed

### Production chain: co-products

- **Co-products** are now supported: some buildings produce several resources (e.g. refinery: fuel and bitumen).
- When you request **fuel** or **bitumen**, the chain shows both outputs, with the requested resource first and the co-product just below (same building).
- Data: `production_co` on recipes; display order handled in the chain sort.

### Production chain: surplus column

- New **Surplus (quantity/day)** column between Quantity/day and Building.
- **Quantity/day** shows only the **required** quantity (what is consumed); co-product rows show **0** in that column.
- Surplus column shows overproduction and co-product output with a **+** and a tooltip with the equivalent **per year**.
- The surplus column is only shown when there is at least one surplus (co-product or overproduction, e.g. 100% charge).

### CI / Deploy

- Deploy workflow runs only on release publication.
- Release publication creates a release branch to support hotfixes.

## Full changelog

- refactor(industry): surplus in dedicated column, quantity/day shows required only
- feat(production): support co-products in production chain
- ci(deploy): create release branch on publish for hotfixes
- ci(deploy): trigger workflow only on release publication

name: v0.1.0
body:
First release of **Soviet Calculator**, a production chain calculator for Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic.

**Features**
- Set production goals (buildings, t/day, t/year) and get the full chain
- View buildings, quantities, personnel, mines, and vehicle config in one table
- Tune source quality, year, charge ratio, and vehicles per resource
- Save multiple plans locally (side panel), share via URL
- French & English (UI, resource/building names, tooltips)

**Try it:** [https://wait4code.github.io/soviet-calculator/](https://wait4code.github.io/soviet-calculator/)

Run locally: `git clone` → `npm install` → `npm run dev`. See [README](https://github.com/Wait4Code/soviet-calculator/blob/v0.1.0/README.md).
